responsibility: Declares the public interface to GCC’s tree/GIMPLE CFG subsystem. It exposes APIs for creating and querying CFG structure, mapping labels and switch cases to blocks and edges, splitting/duplicating SESE regions, CFG verification and dumping, edge and block helpers, cleanup and EH-edge purging entry points, loop/debug printers, and insertion-oriented utilities used broadly by GIMPLE transformation passes.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the public declaration surface for tree CFG operations, exposing macros, inline helpers, and APIs that are implemented in tree-cfg.cc and used by other GIMPLE passes.
